items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: Faulkenberg would pay him off... Faulkenberg said to me-- another man that encouraged me to get a big band

ctx.x: I was right there, and so when he wasn't talking about the gambling what T would do at that time, he had about a twelve piece band which was big money, they were only getting about seven hundred dollars a week, that's less than a hundred dollars apiece, but when they paid T off--Faulkenberg would pay him off--he was married to a woman in Dallas, Texas, he would walk out the back door, get in his car and head for Dalllas and if he won, when he came back they got their money and might get a tip;
What kind of gambling did he do?
